# BSON BinData vector ingestion — facts

## Definitions

- [statement] BSON Binary subtype 9 is a typed vector envelope: it uses a dtype byte and a padding byte before the packed element data, stores values in little-endian form, and defines FLOAT32 (0x27), INT8 (0x03), and PACKED_BIT (0x10) dtypes. Drivers expose explicit vector encode and decode helpers, such as PyMongo's Binary.from_vector() and Binary.as_vector(). (high confidence) — https://github.com/mongodb/specifications/blob/master/source/bson-binary-vector/bson-binary-vector.md · keywords: BSON BinData vector ingestion · also: https://pymongo.readthedocs.io/en/4.15.3/api/bson/binary.html, https://mongodb.github.io/node-mongodb-native/6.12/classes/BSON.Binary.html

## Measurements and reference values

- [statement] MongoDB documents about three times less cluster disk space for BinData vectors than standard float32 arrays. Pre-quantized int8 and int1 representations reduce mongot vector RAM by about 3.75x and 24x respectively; the HNSW graph itself does not shrink, so disk and index-memory savings must be estimated separately. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-20) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/vector-search/about/vector-quantization.md · keywords: BSON BinData vector ingestion · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/vector-search/benchmark/overview/, https://mongodb.com/blog/post/technical/scaling-vector-search-mongodb-atlas-quantization-voyage-ai-embeddings

## Problems, failure modes and limitations

- [statement] A vector query must use the same embedding model as the indexed data and its length must match numDimensions. A full-fidelity query vector can match BinData(float32) data; using a mismatched subtype with int8 or int1 data can return no results without an error. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/search/query/operators-collectors/vectorSearch.md · keywords: BSON BinData vector ingestion · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/vector-search/indexes/vector-search-type.md

## Facts and statements

- [statement] MongoDB Vector Search accepts BSON BinData vector subtypes float32, int8, and int1 in vector index fields. The documented numDimensions range is 1–8192 for int8, a multiple of 8 for int1, and no more than 8192 overall. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/vector-search/indexes/vector-search-type.md · keywords: BSON BinData vector ingestion · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/vector-search/about/vector-quantization.md
- [statement] The client must convert pre-quantized embeddings to BSON BinData subtype 9 before inserting them, using a driver that supports vector encoding. The current MongoDB guide lists minimum supported driver versions, and PyMongo added Binary.from_vector() and Binary.as_vector() in version 4.10. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/vector-search/about/vector-quantization.md · keywords: BSON BinData vector ingestion · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/languages/python/pymongo-driver/current/reference/release-notes/, https://www.mongodb.com/community/forums/t/scalar-quantized-vector-ingestion-now-supported/300147
- [statement] Quantization can trade retrieval precision for lower memory and faster comparisons. MongoDB's benchmark says binary quantization can materially reduce search precision and that rescoring candidates from full-fidelity vectors adds latency, so resource ratios do not guarantee equal quality or lower end-to-end latency for every embedding model and workload. (medium confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/vector-search/benchmark/overview/ · keywords: BSON BinData vector ingestion · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/vector-search/about/vector-quantization.md
- [statement] Embedding APIs can return quantized outputs, but those outputs are not automatically BSON vector values. Voyage AI and Cohere document int8 and binary-family output choices, while BSON subtype 9 requires its own dtype and padding metadata; convert the provider output using a compatible driver and verify the exact binary representation. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-20) — https://docs.voyageai.com/docs/embeddings · keywords: BSON BinData vector ingestion · also: https://docs.cohere.com/docs/embeddings, https://github.com/mongodb/specifications/blob/master/source/bson-binary-vector/bson-binary-vector.md, https://www.mongodb.com/docs/vector-search/about/vector-quantization.md
- [statement] PyMongo 4.10 introduced provisional subtype 9 support, and PyMongo 4.10.1 fixed a subtype 9 bug on big-endian systems. Early PyMongo 4.10.0 deployments on big-endian hosts therefore needed the 4.10.1 fix for portable vector serialization. (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/languages/python/pymongo-driver/current/reference/release-notes/ · keywords: BSON BinData vector ingestion · also: https://www.mongodb.com/community/forums/t/pymongo-4-10-1-released/299573
- [statement] MongoDB Vector Search supports pre-quantized BinData vectors with float32, int8, or int1 types. The documented maximum dimensionality is 8192 for int8, while int1 dimensions must be a multiple of 8; int1 supports euclidean similarity, and int8 supports cosine, euclidean, or dotProduct. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/vector-search/about/vector-quantization.md · keywords: BSON BinData vector ingestion · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/vector-search/crud-embeddings/create-embeddings-manual/
- [statement] The current MongoDB guide lists driver minimums for BinData vector ingestion: C++ 4.1.0, C#/.NET 3.2.0, Go 2.1.0, PyMongo 4.10, Node.js 6.11, Java 5.3.1, and Ruby bson gem 5.1. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/vector-search/about/vector-quantization.md · keywords: BSON BinData vector ingestion · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/vector-search/crud-embeddings/create-embeddings-manual/
- [statement] The PyMongo Binary API provides from_vector(vector, dtype, padding=0), and the Node.js BSON Binary API provides fromFloat32Array, fromInt8Array, and fromPackedBits constructors for subtype-9 vectors. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-20) — https://pymongo.readthedocs.io/en/4.15.3/api/bson/binary.html · keywords: BSON BinData vector ingestion · also: https://mongodb.github.io/node-mongodb-native/6.12/classes/BSON.Binary.html
- [statement] Voyage AI and Cohere embedding APIs expose selectable output formats that include float and quantized integer or packed-binary forms, with supported formats depending on the model. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-20) — https://docs.voyageai.com/docs/embeddings · keywords: BSON BinData vector ingestion · also: https://docs.cohere.com/docs/embeddings
- [statement] Do not write provider binary or ubinary output bytes as a subtype-9 value without conversion: subtype 9 requires dtype and padding metadata before the packed elements. Validate the provider's bit order and padding against PACKED_BIT requirements before ingestion. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-20) — https://github.com/mongodb/specifications/blob/master/source/bson-binary-vector/bson-binary-vector.md · keywords: BSON BinData vector ingestion · also: https://docs.voyageai.com/docs/embeddings, https://docs.cohere.com/docs/embeddings
- [statement] MongoDB documentation estimates that BinData vectors use about three times less disk space than standard float32 arrays; the vector-search HNSW graph remains separate and is not compressed by vector quantization. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/vector-search/about/vector-quantization.md · keywords: BSON BinData vector ingestion · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/vector-search/crud-embeddings/create-embeddings-manual/
